name: MakerWorld 3MF normalizer
description: Makes Bambu Studio and MakerWorld 3MF files open in Cura, PrusaSlicer and other slicers, keeping painted colours, filaments, plates and the designer's print settings.
author: Thingport contributors

screenshots.caption: Bambu Studio projects normalized side by side with the originals: the parts joined, every filament and painted face kept, and the designer's print settings carried over.
The dark theme, with a file's menu and the list of what changed.
A model's 3MF taken from your library, to normalize and add back to the model it came from.
